translate_en|mods/PlayerGreetings/42/med: Cuddle in Bed rest (percent of sleep)
While cuddling in bed (awake), tiredness goes down at this percentage of the rate real sleep clears it. Works with sleep turned off. 0 = no rest.
Kiss, Lap Rest and Cuddle in Bed are for partners only
On: only players who are partners see and can use Kiss, Lap Rest and Cuddle in Bed. Off: anyone can ask, with the normal consent box.
While two partners are close to each other a heart moodle shows and unhappiness is cleared and kept at zero. Apart, stats work normally.
Partners further apart than this go back to normal stats. Between the two distances nothing changes, so the heart doesn't flicker.
Partners this close count as together: the heart shows and sadness is cleared.
